research.lithic.knapping.desc: Stone breaks stone. Strike flint against a hard face and take what shatters off.
research.lithic.cordwork.desc: Twisted fibre holds where bare hands cannot. Everything after this is tied together.
research.lithic.firecraft.desc: Dry reed, loose fibre, and patience. Fire is the difference between a night survived and a night endured.
research.lithic.hidework.desc: A hide left wet rots. A hide left dry keeps. Learn which is which before you waste the animal.
research.lithic.stoneworking.desc: A shaped edge, bound rather than wedged. Slower to make and far better than flint.
research.lithic.kilncraft.desc: Clay that has met real heat holds real heat. This is what makes metal thinkable.
research.lithic.oredressing.desc: Crush it, wash it, throw away most of it. What is left is worth smelting.
research.lithic.bloomery.desc: Charcoal, dressed ore, and hours. The bloom that comes out is not iron yet, but it is close.
lithic.gate.cutting: Your hands are not a blade. You need something that cuts.
lithic.gate.striking: Bare hands will not shift stone. You need something that strikes.
lithic.workbench.locked: You do not understand this yet: %s
lithic.rack.locked: You do not know how to dry this.
lithic.contemplation.nothing: Nothing has occurred to you yet. Go and find something.
lithic.contemplation.insufficient: You have %s insight. The next idea needs %s.
lithic.tally.none: Nothing is ready to learn. Go and find something.
